rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Faxbot is a modern MCP server that provides AI-native T.38 fax transmission capabilities through both cloud (Phaxio) and on-premises (Asterisk SIP) backends, featuring dual transport support for stdio and streamable HTTP with OAuth2 authentication. Built with Node.js and Python variants, it offers comprehensive fax operations including document sending (PDF/TXT), status tracking, and webhook callbacks, with enterprise features like audit logging, HIPAA compliance considerations, and Docker deployment. The implementation includes client SDKs for Node.js and Python, automated installation scripts for Claude Desktop and Cursor integration, and supports both traditional telephony infrastructure and modern cloud fax services, making it ideal for healthcare organizations, legal firms, and businesses requiring reliable programmatic fax capabilities with AI assistant integration.
